extraction_notes: The supplied PDF is the TWGMC datasheet headed AO3401 and SI2305; this record is restricted to AO3401.
The datasheet does not state a revision; PDF metadata title is BC3401 SOT-23.pdf.
Curve points are direct readings at visible grid coordinates from the p. 3 typical-characteristics plots; no interpolated points were added.
The p-channel signs shown in the datasheet are preserved for VDS, VGS, ID, IS, VSD, and threshold values; capacitance and resistance are positive SI magnitudes.
The strict MOSFET schema has no fields for IDSS, IGSS, gFS, switching times, absolute maximum ratings, or thermal resistance. IDSS is published as MAX -1 uA at VDS = -24 V, VGS = 0 V on p. 2.
The datasheet publishes no Qg, trr, or capacitance-versus-VDS curve.
Electrical-characteristics note 1 specifies pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2% for the pulse-test rows.
